\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-24↗ prob:k-point-homogeneous Let $(M,g)$ be a connected Riemannian manifold. Recall the definition of $k$-point homogeneous from Problem 6-18. Prove the following:

  1. If $(M,g)$ is homogeneous, then it has constant scalar curvature.

  2. If $(M,g)$ is 2-point homogeneous, then it is Einstein.

  3. If $(M,g)$ is 3-point homogeneous, then it has constant sectional curvature.

\end{exercise}
